business_problem: Elara Caring needed to simplify fragmented caregiver, HR, IT, and referral processes so a 26,000-person workforce could access the right systems, onboarding, scheduling, and patient information without manual handoffs slowing patient care.
solution_summary: Elara Caring standardized digital operations on ServiceNow to connect caregiver-facing workflows, internal services, and healthcare data. IT Service Management and IT Operations Management established the core operating model and service visibility, while App Engine was used to build low-code applications such as the Medication Administration App, patient-visit text reminders, and a Room & Board workflow that replaced spreadsheets, email, and manual updates. Field Service Management and Workplace Service Delivery then optimized caregiver scheduling based on geography, languages, and care constraints, and HR Service Delivery with Employee Center Pro accelerated onboarding and employee support. Underneath those experiences, Workflow Data Fabric, Integration Hub, and RPA Hub connect Workday, AlayaCare, Homecare Homebase, and other legacy systems so referrals, employee actions, and clinical data can move through one HIPAA-secure platform instead of disconnected tools.

data_flow: Employee, caregiver, and patient operations start in ServiceNow apps and portals, where App Engine workflows, HR Service Delivery, and scheduling tools collect requests and updates. Workflow Data Fabric then synchronizes those workflows with Workday, AlayaCare, and Homecare Homebase so referrals, caregiver assignments, and clinical records move through one coordinated system.
business_outcome: Elara Caring reduced some onboarding flows from weeks to one day, optimized 400K hours of care per month, supports 1.4K new hires monthly, forecasts 20% IT cost savings, and improved patient experience by digitizing field, HR, and referral workflows on one platform.
metrics: 1 day to onboard instead of weeks
400K hours of care optimized per month
architecture_clues: The deployment runs on a HIPAA-secure platform.
Workflow Data Fabric uses Integration Hub and RPA Hub to connect multiple legacy healthcare and HR systems.
Healthcare and Life Sciences Service Management supports HL7 FHIR compliance in Elara's roadmap.
evidence_quotes: With ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM) and IT Operations Management (ITOM), Elara Caring streamlined its IT operations and built a solid base to apply new solutions and digitize all processes and workflows for caregivers in patient's homes, as well as for care coordinators in the back office.
One example is the Medication Administration App, a digitized patient form used by caregivers to document the administration of medications during a patient visit.
To further simplify operations and improve caregiver experience, Elara Caring adopted ServiceNow HR Service Delivery (HRSD) and Talent Development.
Onboarding time for new staff members has, in some instances, been reduced from weeks to a single day.

Workflow Data Fabric-more specifically, Integration Hub and Robotic Process Automation (RPA) Hub-is used to connect to systems like AlayaCare, Workday, and the company's primary electronic medical records (EMR) system, Homecare Homebase.
